problems.title: Solve x squared
hints: Take the square root of both sides.
problems.solution:
Square-root both sides:

$$x^2 = 25 \;\Rightarrow\; x = \pm 5$$

The positive solution is $x = 5$.

problems.title: Factor a quadratic
problems.scenario: Which is the correct factorisation of $x^2 + 5x + 6$?
hints: Find two numbers that multiply to 6 and add to 5.
problems.solution:
Two numbers multiplying to $+6$ and adding to $+5$ are $2$ and $3$:

$$x^2 + 5x + 6 = (x+2)(x+3)$$

Expanding confirms it.

problems.title: Roots from factors
hints: A product is zero when a factor is zero.
problems.solution:
Set each factor to zero:

$$x - 4 = 0 \Rightarrow x = 4, \qquad x + 2 = 0 \Rightarrow x = -2$$

The positive root is $x = 4$.

problems.title: Larger root of a quadratic
problems.scenario: The equation $x^2 + 5x + 6 = 0$ has two roots. Give the **larger** one.
problems.solution:
Factor and solve:

$$(x+2)(x+3) = 0 \;\Rightarrow\; x = -2 \text{ or } x = -3$$

The larger root is $x = -2$ (since $-2 > -3$).

problems.title: Compute the discriminant
problems.solution:
Substitute $a=1, b=2, c=1$:

$$\Delta = b^2 - 4ac = 4 - 4 = 0$$

A zero discriminant means one (repeated) root.

problems.title: Quadratic formula
hints: Factor or use the formula with $a=1,b=-5,c=6$.
problems.solution:
Factor (or use the formula):

$$x^2 - 5x + 6 = (x-2)(x-3) = 0 \;\Rightarrow\; x = 2 \text{ or } 3$$

Larger root: $x = 3$.

problems.title: No middle term
problems.solution:
Isolate $x^2$ and take the root:

$$2x^2 - 8 = 0 \;\Rightarrow\; x^2 = 4 \;\Rightarrow\; x = \pm 2$$

Positive root: $x = 2$.

problems.title: Factor and solve
hints: Two numbers multiplying to 12 and adding to $-7$.
problems.solution:
Find factors of 12 adding to $-7$ → $-3$ and $-4$:

$$x^2 - 7x + 12 = (x-3)(x-4) = 0 \;\Rightarrow\; x = 3 \text{ or } x = 4$$

problems.title: Mixed-sign factors
problems.scenario: Solve $x^2 + x - 6 = 0$ and give the **positive** root.
hints: Two numbers multiplying to $-6$ and adding to $+1$.
problems.solution:
Factors of $-6$ adding to $+1$ are $+3$ and $-2$:

$$x^2 + x - 6 = (x+3)(x-2) = 0 \;\Rightarrow\; x = -3 \text{ or } x = 2$$

Positive root: $x = 2$.

problems.title: Formula with a ≠ 1
problems.solution:
Apply the quadratic formula:

$$x = \frac{-3 \pm \sqrt{3^2 - 4(2)(-2)}}{2(2)} = \frac{-3 \pm \sqrt{25}}{4} = \frac{-3 \pm 5}{4}$$

So $x = \tfrac{2}{4} = 0.5$ or $x = -2$. Positive root: $x = 0.5$.

problems.title: Discriminant: no real roots
problems.scenario:
Find the discriminant $b^2 - 4ac$ of

$$3x^2 + 2x + 5 = 0$$

(A negative value means no real roots.)
problems.solution:
Substitute $a=3, b=2, c=5$:

$$\Delta = 2^2 - 4(3)(5) = 4 - 60 = -56$$

Since $\Delta < 0$, there are no real roots — the parabola never crosses the $x$-axis.
